independent_confirmation.comparison: Same pilot endpoint against the calibrated native actor, greedy play.
independent_confirmation.decision: Require positive independent utility, positive pooled utility lower 95% bound, independent paired T12 log-body lower 95% bound >= -0.12, and a positive pooled point estimate for T9-to-T12 growth or T14 log body. Review reach, original mechanisms, same-state low-health behavior, and exact-field utility bounds before spending the overnight budget.
